difficultyRationale: Requires distinguishing persistent instance state from fields that default serialization does not save.
prompt: Under default Java object serialization, which fields are not part of the default serialized instance state? Select all that apply.
explanation: Default serialization writes the non-static, non-transient fields of a serializable object. Static fields belong to the class rather than the individual object, and transient fields are explicitly excluded.

options.explanation: Static fields are class state, not default serialized instance state.
The transient modifier excludes the field from default serialization.
These are the core fields included by default serialization when their values are serializable as required.
Final instance fields are not excluded merely because they are final.

references.title: Java Object Serialization Specification: Serializable Fields
